steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee... Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yes, right there, cut down into it hard... keep cutting... harder...
Wendy stares intently at an electronic screen in a cramped little space. A video feed from a reconnaissance aircraft loops on the screen.

The image shows a young girl chasing after those indescribable creatures with a massive chainsaw in her hands. After cutting them to pieces, the corners of her mouth part to reveal sharp teeth, and a guttural laugh springs up from her throat.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Beautiful...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hm, well... This is how it should be.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yes, struggle... and scream! Hahaha!
Wendy sits on a chair in the center of the interrogation room, her hands and feet bound with special chains.
The image is clearly a chilling one, yet she watches it with a smile on her face, her satisfaction evident from her expression.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yes, of course I do! This is the first time I’ve had pictures and videos taken of me. I’m thrilled!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: So this is how I look when I’m working... Hehe, looks great.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Are there any others? I wanna see more!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Very well shot... It’s a shame it’s just me, but thanks anyway.
Seeing you update the audiovisuals, Wendy watches amenably for a while before turning her head to look at you.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: What... were you just doing?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: There’s a familiar smell on you. *Sniff sniff*

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Can I smell you? Come here, come over here.
She looks at you expectantly with limpid eyes, but there's something about her gaze that makes your skin crawl.
You think back to the test report—Wendy is believed to be a Class 1 mutant made highly unstable by the effects of Mania.
Wendy is securely fastened to the interrogation room chair. You casually take two small steps forward.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hmm... such a familiar scent... It’s on your neck, too, so soft and slender... Can I feel it?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I want to touch it... Do your cuts bleed red, too?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahahahaha!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You have the stench of death on you, too! Just like the Rust!!
She grows agitated and impatient as she repeatedly sniffs at the air around her. Finally, her eyes land on you and she erupts in strange laughter.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I know... mmm... this scent! It’s the gift the Rust gave me—a soft and fluffy little cake! Hahaha! Cut it into slices, one for me, one for him... but for you...? All I’m gonna give you is a nice funeral! Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Ah... Can’t, huh? But it’s really important...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Your neck... looks soft and tender... and that pulsing artery... I can see the blood flowing through it...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I like your body. Just what is that scent on it anyway...? It’s so familiar...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Oh, oh!! I know now, ahahahaha! It’s the stench of death!! Just like the Rust!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: A big banquet by the Rust—Gluttony buried in heaps of trash, alternating red and white cream, cut into slices one by one—Hahaha! Let me look into the incision and see if what's flowing out is sewage... or nasty sludge...!
The chair shakes and rocks under her as the chains scrape violently against each other, producing a bloodcurdling sound.

You finally remember that this is the Reaper of the Rust, a maniac who bathes in blood and dances with monsters. To catch this frightening specter, you spent almost the entire night circling the Rust with her.
She's a lunatic, and her madness is tainted by the scent of blood. Fear starts to slowly spread through your body.
Still, you resist the urge to run, checking the status of the restraints instead. She is a key suspect—the interrogation must continue.

This is an investigation report about the Mania weapon.

It's an evil weapon made using crystallized Mania. The gangs covet the Sinister Singularities' power, even if it infects them with Mania, turns innocent people into monsters, and floods the Syndicate with rivers of blood.
The FAC has yet to uncover the Mania weapon's creator, but it has locked on to the source of the earliest batch of those evil crystals—the Rust.
High-grade Mania crystals are obtained from Sinner experimentation, while high yields of low-grade crystals are refined from the many Corruptor remains piled up on the Rust.
Immediately after, a body-snatching ring suspected of reselling Corruptor remains surfaced. And the first suspect to get caught in the net? She's sitting right in front of you.
I'll ask you some questions to get a better sense of the whole story. Please answer them if you can.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: If I do... will you let me go? I miss my friends back home.

options: That depends on how well you cooperate.

choices.text: That depends on how well you cooperate.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee hee... You will. You know I belong back there.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahahaha, okay! I like you more and more!
You ignore her chilling laughter and turn on the virtual projection. A number of photos appear before Wendy.
Red-black liquid containing contaminants mixed with unnameable detritus trickles over the ground, staining the land black.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: The Rust! The place where I belong...
You seem to know the ins and outs of the Rust. Are there many monsters?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Monsters? You mean the Corruptors, or me?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee, whatever it is, there's always a lot... Alive, dead, inhuman... all kinds.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Monster remains, blue rain, black mud, impossibly dangerous garbage, and people with no place to go... Whatever you don't want ends up in the Rust. The Rust welcomes all.
From the data you've consulted, the Rust was specially demarcated as an abandoned zone.

Beginning in Nightfall 84, pollutants and biological tissues that couldn't be disposed of were dumped into the Rust, gradually turning it into a cradle of monstrosities. It's also a haunt for dangerous outlaws.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee, why are you always staring at me like that?

Our investigation revealed that most of the raw materials used to make the Mania weapon came from the Rust. So, we believe there are people nearby who are stealing Corruptors and extracting biological material from them as "merchandise".
They can carve their "merchandise" into small pieces and move them away, and they're strong enough to fight the Corruptors.
Is that what you do, Wendy?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Carve... Did you say "carve"?! Yes, yes, yes! I like doing this, and I like chasing them, too... and listening to that piercing sound they make... Hahaha!
You're a suspect, and that's a felony.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Ahahaha! The carving, that was definitely me!! I was at the Rust! I cut up the pretty cake into pieces, they were like beehives, soft... sticky... disgusting!!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Do you wanna know what it feels like, too?
Wendy looks at you, making no effort to conceal her desire to eat you whole.
You admit to gathering Corruptor remains and collecting contaminated tissues from them. Correct? To what end?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee, that was the mission!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Bodies dumped in the Rust, wandering Corruptors, cute little monsters... None can leave the Rust...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I’d find them, cut them up, cut them to pieces... There’s no higher honor than this mission!

options: Who tasked you with this mission?

choices.text: Who tasked you with this mission?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Who...?
Wendy gives you a cold and eerie look, then lowers her voice to a whine like an overhead extractor fan...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Who gave me the mission never mattered... I just wanted this mission.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Their bodies are slightly decayed and ooze dark chocolate paste... And the toys buried in the paste jump and jump... while the little cherries dotting the cake giggle and snicker.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: We spent every single day together and played with them! Sharing their flavor... listening to their cries and dreaming beautiful dreams... Hee hee hee...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You know what? Those things decay in a way you can't even imagine. They're half meat-stink, half... crawling black mud.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I have to separate them carefully and clean them well, then save the black stuff. They’re like a pool of barf...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Bleuugh!
Wendy makes an awful vomiting sound with her throat, letting saliva drip down onto the tips of her shoes.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Rotting bit by bit, chopping piece by piece!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Death and death, grave after grave!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Go to ****ing hell and make a deal with the Devil!
She shakes violently, giving you a fright as the chains restraining her collide together with a series of ear-piercing sounds.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Ahahahaha!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You little coward, hiding behind your power like trash!
You've already grown accustomed to these sudden crazed outbursts of hers and are getting tired of her jumbled answers.
You even start to think that it's not impossible that she could be going to all this effort just to obfuscate her crimes.

According to the FAC's investigative report, the trafficking of Corruptor remains near the Rust is a highly developed trade with the flawless technique when it comes to selling, stealing, transporting, and concealment.
This just isn't something that a mere "lunatic" could pull off.
We have reason to suspect that you have a partner or collaborator. Is it a Syndicate gang?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Syndicate? Where’s that?
Sigh... I can hardly keep my eyes open...
Are the mobsters who are after the Mania weapon your partners?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Don’t compare us to them.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: My companions are way more refined and powerful than they are.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee hee... That's right, my companions, friends, and family who I'd give my life for... not like those chuckleheads, and not like you, either!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I have a LOT of companions!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: We’re very strong, and glorious, too... We carry out missions together and bring light to this world! Hee hee hee...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: We’re always together, and no monster is a match for us.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: They turn to corpses in the Rust, and all the corpses are ours...
Her voice gradually trails off as her smile grows deeper. Your intuition tells you that she believes every maniacal word she's saying.
Her companions... What could they be like?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Who? Uh... my friends? My family?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: They’re at home... but I brought their stuff.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Why don’t you look for them yourself?
A rusty chain slips out from the clothing on Wendy's chest, looking out of place among the other items on her person.
You walk over to her side and gently lift up the chain—it's a metal chain with several dog tags hanging from it. You can feel the heat it carried from Wendy's body in your palm.
The dozen or so metal dog tags strung on the chain sway gently, reflecting a cold ray of light—This isn't an emblem of any Syndicate gang.

Their style is sharp and the information is encrypted, it would appear they're part of a highly systematized organization. And the material is some sort of high-grade alloy, meaning that this organization has considerable support in terms of equipment and supplies.
But their surfaces are covered in contaminants and bloodstains. They've clearly seen countless deaths and battles.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Ah! My companions, my comrades, my family...
This time, the affection in her voice makes your hair stand on end.
A large, elite organization like this not only has control of the Rust and the Corruptor remains, but they have a Sinner like Wendy, too...
And you didn't realize they even existed until now?!

options: What kind of organization are you?

choices.text: What kind of organization are you?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Are you scared? Are you scared, Chief? Hahahahaha!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Don’t be afraid of us, what’s there to be afraid of? How could you forget about us?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: As the FAC’s dog, you should know everything about us!
The FAC's dog...?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: The blood flowed into the machine, branding us into this thing...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Like a dog chain... tethering us all.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You don’t remember? ...The genetic brand.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Everyone had to undergo genetic branding, it made their corpses easier to identify after the war.
Genetic branding?!
They used lasers to engrave individual blood ions on special metal dog tags—that's the FAC's original technology!
You mean...?!
You forcefully wipe the stains from the surface of the dog tag and to reveal a few letters from under the years of filth overlaying it—
W...Mortician?
In the blink of an eye, Wendy grows unusually quiet. Now, the only noise you can hear in the interrogation room is the humming of various monitoring instruments.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: It’s been a long time... since anyone called us that.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Ah, poor undertakers!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Slumbering under a cold mound of dirt...
The ID on this dog tag is from the FAC troops... Were you with the FAC?
But... how did you end up at the Rust? Why would you get involved with the Mania weapon? ...And why didn't any of this come up in the investigative report?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hehe... Hehe... Hahahahaha...
No longer answering your questions, all that remains in the interrogation room is Wendy's unsettling crazed laughter.

options: Contact Nightingale to investigate the truth

choices.text: Contact Nightingale to investigate the truth
